title: 사립학교보조와원조에관한건 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (31) Omitted.

(32) The Decree on Subsidies and Assistance for Private Schools is partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1) and (2), the main clause and proviso of Article 4 (1), the part of Article 4 (2) other than its subparagraphs, the part of Article 5 (1) other than its subparagraphs, subparagraph 5 of that paragraph, and Article 5 (2), the term "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced, respectively, with "Minister of Education".

(33) through (61) Omitted.
